mapper.select: SELECT C.COMN_CD AS GRP, D.COMN_DTL_CD AS CD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_NM AS NM FROM TB_EEP_COMN_CD_M C JOIN TB_EEP_COMN_DTL_CD_S D ON D.COMN_CD_SQ = C.COMN_CD_SQ WHERE C.COMN_CD REGEXP '^(HR|EQP|LAB|BONUS|MEM|FB)_' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.COMN_CD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD IS NULL, D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_SQ

SELECT I.INTV_SQ, I.SEQ_NO, I.APLY_NM, I.GENDER , DATE_FORMAT(I.INTV_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS INTV_DT , I.INTV_TM, I.APLY_TARGET, I.APLY_ROUTE, I.REFERRER, I.LANG_NOTE, I.PHONE, I.ATTEND_ST, I.EDU, I.AGE, I.ADDR, I.STATION , I.CAREER, I.LANG, I.LOCAL_YN, I.HOBBY, I.SPECIALTY, I.SALARY
, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(M.CONTENT ORDER BY M.MEMO_SQ DESC SEPARATOR '\n') FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'INTV' AND M.TARGET_SQ = I.INTV_SQ) AS MEMO , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'INTV' AND M.TARGET_SQ = I.INTV_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT , I.RESULT_ST, I.NOTICE_ST, I.JOIN_ST, I.JOIN_DT , T.TRN_SQ FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M I LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M T ON T.INTV_SQ = I.INTV_SQ ORDER BY I.INTV_DT DESC, I.INTV_TM DESC, I.INTV_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M ( SEQ_NO, APLY_NM, GENDER, INTV_DT, INTV_TM, APLY_TARGET, APLY_ROUTE, PHONE, ATTEND_ST, EDU, AGE, ADDR, STATION , CAREER, LANG, LOCAL_YN, MEMO, HOBBY, SPECIALTY, SALARY, RESULT_ST, NOTICE_ST, JOIN_ST, JOIN_DT , REFERRER, LANG_NOTE, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) + 1, #{APLY_NM}, #{GENDER}, NULLIF(#{INTV_DT}, ''), #{INTV_TM}, #{APLY_TARGET}, #{APLY_ROUTE}, #{PHONE}, #{ATTEND_ST}, #{EDU}, #{AGE}, #{ADDR}, #{STATION} , #{CAREER}, #{LANG}, #{LOCAL_YN}, #{MEMO}, #{HOBBY}, #{SPECIALTY}, #{SALARY}, #{RESULT_ST}, #{NOTICE_ST}, #{JOIN_ST}, #{JOIN_DT} , #{REFERRER}, #{LANG_NOTE}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M

INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M ( SEQ_NO, STATUS_CD, TRN_NM, GENDER, EDU, AGE, ADDR, STATION, CAREER, LANG, LANG_NOTE, LOCAL_YN, MEMO, EDU_START_DT , INTV_SQ, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT ) SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) + 1 FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M), 'ING', I.APLY_NM, I.GENDER, I.EDU, I.AGE, I.ADDR, I.STATION, I.CAREER, I.LANG, I.LANG_NOTE, I.LOCAL_YN, I.MEMO , IF(I.JOIN_DT REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$', I.JOIN_DT, NULL) , I.INTV_SQ, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M I WHERE I.INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M T WHERE T.INTV_SQ = I.INTV_SQ);
INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R (TARGET_CD, TARGET_SQ, CONTENT, EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) SELECT 'TRAINEE', T.TRN_SQ, M.CONTENT, M.EMPLY_ID, M.REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M JOIN TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M T ON T.INTV_SQ = M.TARGET_SQ WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'INTV' AND M.TARGET_SQ = #{INTV_SQ} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R X WHERE X.TARGET_CD = 'TRAINEE' AND X.TARGET_SQ = T.TRN_SQ) ORDER BY M.MEMO_SQ
mapper.select: SELECT TRN_SQ, SEQ_NO, STATUS_CD, LEAVE_NOTE, TRN_NM, GENDER, EDU, AGE, ADDR, STATION, CAREER, LANG, LANG_NOTE , LOCAL_YN, EARLY_YN, SPECIAL_YN , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(M.CONTENT ORDER BY M.MEMO_SQ DESC SEPARATOR '\n') FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'TRAINEE' AND M.TARGET_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M.TRN_SQ) AS MEMO , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_ROW_MEMO_R M WHERE M.TARGET_CD = 'TRAINEE' AND M.TARGET_SQ = TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M.TRN_SQ) AS MEMO_CNT , DATE_FORMAT(EDU_START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS EDU_START_DT , EDU_WEEK, INTERVIEW_YN, INTERVIEW_AVAIL , SK_JSP, SK_THYMELEAF, SK_VUE, SK_REACT, SK_NODE_FE, SK_SPRING, SK_JAVA, SK_NODE_BE, SK_NEXACRO, SK_WEBSQUARE, SK_EXBUILDER FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M ORDER BY EDU_START_DT DESC, TRN_SQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M ( SEQ_NO, STATUS_CD, LEAVE_NOTE, TRN_NM, GENDER, EDU, AGE, ADDR, STATION, CAREER, LANG, LANG_NOTE, LOCAL_YN, EARLY_YN, SPECIAL_YN, MEMO , EDU_START_DT, INTERVIEW_YN, INTERVIEW_AVAIL, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT ) SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO), 0) + 1, #{STATUS_CD}, #{LEAVE_NOTE}, #{TRN_NM}, #{GENDER}, #{EDU}, #{AGE}, #{ADDR}, #{STATION}, #{CAREER}, #{LANG}, #{LANG_NOTE}, #{LOCAL_YN}, #{EARLY_YN}, #{SPECIAL_YN}, #{MEMO} , NULLIF(#{EDU_START_DT}, ''), #{INTERVIEW_YN}, #{INTERVIEW_AVAIL}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW() FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_INTV_M SET REFERRER = NULL WHERE INTV_SQ = #{INTV_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT STATUS_CD FROM TB_EEP_HR_TRAINEE_M WHERE TRN_SQ = #{TRN_SQ}
